summary: Comprehensive testing of 3-step purchase flow for Faithful Threads e-commerce. All backend Design API tests (17/17) passed. Frontend UI testing verified the complete flow: Step 1 (Product Selection with progress indicator), Step 2 (Design Selection filtered by category), Step 3 (Review Order with mockup preview). Admin Designs page tested for design upload functionality.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test designs for testing: 'Faith Over Fear Cross' (apparel) and 'Blessed Hat Logo' (hats)
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-step purchase flow fully implemented and tested. Design API endpoints working: GET /api/designs (with category filter), POST /api/admin/designs, DELETE /api/admin/designs/{id}, PUT /api/admin/designs/{id}, POST /api/admin/designs/upload. Frontend pages working: ProductDetailPage (Step 1 with progress indicator), DesignSelectionPage (Step 2 with category filtering), ReviewOrderPage (Step 3 with mockup preview). Admin Designs page allows uploading designs with category selection. Two test designs created for demonstration.
